{{Quote|Zonama Sekot not only tugged one of Coruscant's moons out of orbit, but also tore apart the planetary ring that the Yuuzhan Vong manufactured from the moon ''they'' managed to shatter.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="TUF">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]''</ref>}}
'''Centax-3''' was one of the four [[Moon/Legends|moons]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="CatCW" />

==History==
[[File:Coruscant_system-TPM.jpg|thumb|left|285px|The planet Coruscant and three of its four moons]]
In [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]], during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|took]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] from the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and began [[Terraforming/Legends|terraforming]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. During the process, Centax-3 was either [[Rings of Coruscant|destroyed]] or ejected from [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]].<ref name="Traitor">''[[The New Jedi Order: Traitor]]''</ref><ref name="Note">Although ''[[The New Jedi Order: Traitor]]'' does not specify which of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] four [[Moon/Legends|moons]] was destroyed to create [[Rings of Coruscant|the Bridge]], the destroyed moon must have been either [[Centax-1/Legends|Centax-1]] or Centax-3, as the two remaining moons, [[Centax-2/Legends|Centax-2]] and [[Hesperidium/Legends|Hesperidium]], both appeared in stories dated after the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. Centax-2 was featured in ''[[Legacy of the Force: Bloodlines]]'', and Hesperidium in ''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]''.</ref>
